mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds regardless of the absolute rate level.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points in the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by > 0.1pp in the last month
evidence_refs: doc:Unemployment Rate and Equity Market Correlation
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Combined labor market weakness (UNRATE > 5.5%) and reduced consumer spending (RSAFS below 12-month moving average) signal a contractionary economic environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5 and RSAFS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates applied to equity valuations.
evidence_refs: doc:Monetary Policy and Equity Market Returns
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index base 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Industrial Production and Equity Market Returns
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1000 thousand units signals weak residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Housing Market and Equity Market Correlation
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high labor market slack (UNRATE > 5.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and lower corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending above its 12-month moving average signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Consumer Spending and Equity Market Returns
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
